modules.name: Passive Recon: API Docs & Specs Exposure
modules.description: Detects exposure of API documentation, specs, and interactive consoles observed in traffic.
modules.recommendationSummary: Restrict API documentation endpoints to authenticated users where appropriate. Disable interactive consoles in production or protect them with strong auth.

modules.name: Passive Recon: Cache & Privacy Posture
modules.description: Flags potentially risky cacheability for responses that appear user-specific and missing cache partitioning indicators.
modules.recommendationSummary: Mark authenticated or user-specific responses as Cache-Control: no-store. Use appropriate Vary headers for responses that change by user or origin.

modules.name: Passive Recon: Client Config & Secret-Like Values
modules.description: Flags secret-like tokens and exposed configuration values in observed HTML/JS/JSON responses. These are recon leads; validate sensitivity before reporting.
modules.recommendationSummary: Remove secrets from client-delivered assets and rotate exposed credentials. Use automated secret scanning in CI/CD and pre-commit hooks.

modules.name: Passive Recon: CORS Posture Indicators
modules.description: Adds passive CORS posture checks: missing Vary: Origin for dynamic ACAO, and permissive allowed headers/methods.
modules.recommendationSummary: Include Vary: Origin for dynamic CORS responses. Restrict allowed methods/headers to what is necessary.

modules.name: Passive Recon: Error & Stack Trace Disclosure
modules.description: Detects common framework stack traces, error pages, and path disclosures in observed responses.
modules.recommendationSummary: Return generic error messages to clients and log detailed errors server-side. Disable debug/error pages in production and scrub internal paths/hostnames from responses.

modules.name: Passive Recon: Interesting Endpoint Patterns
modules.description: Flags high-value endpoint patterns observed in traffic (admin panels, debug endpoints, consoles, and backup/config file paths).
modules.recommendationSummary: Restrict administrative and debug endpoints behind strong authentication and network controls. Remove unused consoles and do not deploy backup/config files to production.

modules.name: Passive Recon: Internal Hosts & Environment Hints
modules.description: Detects internal hostnames/IPs and environment hints (staging/dev/local) disclosed in observed responses.
modules.recommendationSummary: Remove internal hostnames/IPs from client responses. Ensure staging/dev configuration is not exposed to production clients.

modules.name: Passive Recon: High-Risk Parameter Names
modules.description: Flags request parameters and JSON keys commonly associated with high-impact findings (open redirect, SSRF, IDOR, file/path traversal).
modules.recommendationSummary: Review identified parameters for input validation and strong authorization checks. For redirect parameters, enforce allowlists and avoid open redirects. For URL fetch/webhook parameters, enforce strict allowlists and block internal IP ranges.

modules.name: Passive Recon: Source Maps & Debug Artifacts
modules.description: Detects source map references and common debug artifacts in observed HTML/JS responses. These are high-value recon leads for code disclosure and hidden endpoints.
modules.recommendationSummary: Do not publish source maps to production unless required; restrict access or strip sourceMappingURL references. Disable development tooling and verbose debug banners in production builds.

modules.name: Passive Recon: Tokens & Secrets in URLs
modules.description: Detects access tokens, JWTs, and API keys present in URLs or query strings observed in traffic.
modules.recommendationSummary: Avoid placing secrets in URLs. Use Authorization headers or secure cookies. Rotate exposed tokens and ensure logs/analytics do not persist sensitive URLs.

modules.name: Passive Recon: .well-known & Metadata Files
modules.description: Flags security-relevant well-known resources and metadata files when they appear in observed traffic.
modules.recommendationSummary: Ensure well-known endpoints do not leak internal configuration or secrets. Review metadata contents and limit exposure where needed.

modules.name: Access control coverage probes

modules.recommendationSummary: Enforce authorization on the server for every endpoint and every object access. Do not trust client-side role indicators. Ignore untrusted rewrite headers for authorization decisions. Apply deny-by-default authorization checks consistently.

modules.name: Access control IDOR/BOLA probes
modules.description: Tests object-level authorization by mutating object identifiers in path, query, and body parameters.
modules.recommendationSummary: Use strict server-side validation and authorization checks. Reject malformed, unexpected, and privilege-escalating input.

modules.name: Access control multi-identity diff
modules.description: Reserved multi-identity access-control differential family. It stays capability-gated until the scan engine can replay the same request across multiple identities.

modules.name: API mass assignment probes
modules.description: Generic API mass-assignment probes using baseline-vs-mutated differential confirmation.
modules.recommendationSummary: Use strict server-side schema validation and per-field authorization checks. Reject unexpected privilege/financial/state fields and enforce allow-lists for writable attributes.

modules.name: API parameter pollution probes
modules.description: Tests conflicting parameter encodings and nested structures that trigger parser confusion.
modules.recommendationSummary: Use strict server-side validation and authorization checks. Reject malformed, unexpected, and privilege-escalating input.

modules.name: Authentication coverage probes
